impact:
VAL-CAP-004 row expects "1080p60 monitor capture" but the xdg-desktop-portal delivered format XR24 3840×2160 fps_num=0 fps_den=1 (4K native resolution, variable framerate). Observed diagnostics fps was ~105fps. Even after ISS-001 (harness fps_num=0 fix) is resolved, a 60fps cadence gate would still fail since the actual capture runs at ~105fps 4K.

Resolution plan (design pass 2026-05-18, .story/handovers/2026-05-18-04-iss-003-design.md): chosen path D3 — rescope validation to the negotiated matrix cell. The row schema gains additive expectedCaptureFormat (width/height) and expectedEncoderBackend fields (mirroring ISS-001's nominalFps additive pattern). driveValCap004 asserts negotiated sessionReady.format.width × height equals the declared expectedCaptureFormat; mismatch surfaces as a precise ThresholdResult (capture cell matches declared) with passed=false — never a silent pass. deriveThresholdKey keys off the declared cell, not the negotiated cell, so the drop tier reflects row intent. nominalFps source-tracking from ISS-001 is preserved verbatim. No capture-layer or encoder-layer Rust change.

Implementation status (2026-05-18, T-023 — storybloq auto-numbered; the prompt requested T-021a but storybloq rejected umbrella linkage because T-010c blocks on T-021): IMPLEMENTATION COMPLETE, PENDING RERUN. validation/rows.ts adds optional SmokeRow fields expectedCaptureFormat, expectedEncoderBackend, onCellMismatch ("fail" | "skip"); VAL-CAP-004 annotated with expectedCaptureFormat={width:1920,height:1080}, expectedEncoderBackend="nvenc", onCellMismatch="fail". validation/drivers.ts deriveThresholdKey accepts optional declared format + declared encoder backend and prefers them; driveValCap004 records declaredCaptureFormat, negotiatedCaptureFormat, cellMismatch, expectedEncoderBackend in thresholds.json additively (existing captureFormat / encoderObserved / nominalFps / nominalSource preserved), short-circuits to a "host-cell-mismatch" skip with message containing host-does-not-deliver-declared-cell when onCellMismatch==="skip" AND cells mismatch, and adds a "capture cell matches declared (WxH)" ThresholdResult before the drop/cadence/backend gates. Encoder backend gate name/required/passed now use row.expectedEncoderBackend (default "nvenc"). validation/types.ts adds additive SkipReason "host-cell-mismatch". Verified: npm run typecheck clean, npm run validate:build clean, npm run build clean. Status remains OPEN because no T-021 rerun has been performed against the new gate yet; ISS-003 flips to resolved only after a per-row report on the M1 4K host shows the precise cell-mismatch ThresholdResult (or matrix-gated skip) instead of the prior vague cadence failure. ISS-002 remains independent and untouched; T-010a / T-021 / T-010c statuses unchanged; no helper/electron/src/packaging/Cargo file modified.
title: VAL-CAP-004 capture workload mismatch — portal delivered 4K/variable-fps instead of 1080p60
